name: Physlib Maintenance Report: Improvements to the Physlib website
description: Physlib Contribution Report on work by Alex Zughaid: “Improvements to the Physlib website”.

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

credentialSubject.narrative:
- Added monthly contributions page, AI guidelines, GitHub contribution guide.
- Redesigned the website home page.
- Added 'lake exe get_cache' to speed up the setup process for new users.

achievement.name: Physlib Maintenance Report
achievement.description: For work that keeps Physlib building and usable: updating it when Lean or Mathlib release new versions, fixing what those updates break, and looking after the automatic build checks (CI), linters, documentation and the issue tracker.

criteria.narrative:
- The work was maintenance of Physlib or its infrastructure, for example version updates, CI, linting, replacing deprecated lemmas, tooling or issue triage.
- The work was merged or otherwise adopted by the project.
- Links to the relevant pull requests, commits or issues are given as evidence.
